name: Tailwind Flip Square
css:
.loader { display: inline-block; width: var(--loader-size); height: var(--loader-size); border-radius: calc(var(--loader-size) * .18); background: var(--loader-color); animation: twFlip calc(var(--loader-speed) * 1.6) ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes twFlip { 0% { transform: perspective(140px) rotateX(0deg) rotateY(0deg); } 50% { transform: perspective(140px) rotateX(-180deg) rotateY(0deg); } 100% { transform: perspective(140px) rotateX(-180deg) rotateY(-180deg); } }
tailwind:
{/* keyframes twFlip: rotateX(-180deg) then rotateY(-180deg) with perspective(140px) */}
<span className="inline-block h-13 w-13 animate-[twFlip_1.6s_ease-in-out_infinite] rounded-lg bg-rose-500" />
